title: HMGCR-driven cholesterol metabolism dysregulation and its role in osteoarthritis diagnosis and immune regulation.
one_liner_zh: 该研究聚焦骨关节炎中胆固醇代谢与免疫调控，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系、结合建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Osteoarthritis (OA) is the most common degenerative joint disease, and the complexity of its molecular mechanisms has hindered the development of effective diagnostic and therapeutic strategies. In this study, we integrated five independent OA RNA-seq datasets and applied differential expression analysis combined with LASSO machine learning to identify cholesterol metabolism dysregulation as a central feature of OA synovial tissue, pinpointing 3-hydroxy-3-methylglutaryl-CoA reductase (HMGCR) as a key biomarker. Further analyses revealed that elevated HMGCR expression correlated with increased immune cell infiltration complexity and heightened immune checkpoint molecule activity. In vitro validation demonstrated that the use of the HMGCR inhibitor simvastatin reduced cholesterol metabolism and NF-kappaB signaling, supporting a functional link between metabolic and inflammatory pathways. This study systematically elucidates the role of a cholesterol metabolism-immune axis in OA pathogenesis and provides a theoretical basis for developing metabolism- and immune-targeted therapeutic strategies.
abstract_zh: 骨关节炎（OA）是最常见的退行性关节疾病，其分子机制的复杂性阻碍了有效诊断和治疗策略的开发。在本研究中，我们整合了五个独立的OA RNA-seq数据集，并应用差异表达分析结合LASSO机器学习，将胆固醇代谢失调确定为OA滑膜组织的核心特征，并锁定3-羟基-3-甲基戊二酰辅酶A还原酶（HMGCR）作为关键生物标志物。进一步分析显示，HMGCR表达升高与免疫细胞浸润复杂性增加及免疫检查点分子活性增强相关。体外验证表明，使用HMGCR抑制剂辛伐他汀可降低胆固醇代谢和NF-kappaB信号传导，支持代谢与炎症通路之间的功能联系。本研究系统阐明了胆固醇代谢-免疫轴在OA发病机制中的作用，并为开发代谢和免疫靶向治疗策略提供了理论基础。
